workflow_hypothesis: Insufficient lookahead causes out-of-bounds read during character-sequence encoding
pattern: Boundary-unsafe speculative lookahead in text processing.
description: A text-processing routine inspects a neighboring character while evaluating a multi-element candidate or optimized search path, although the current position may be at the logical input boundary.
precondition: The input ends at the current processing position, while a candidate probe or optimized mismatch/skip path may require one additional character.
critical_operation: The routine uses a pointer or index for the current element and performs candidate probing, mismatch handling, or skip logic that reads the following element.
interference: The remaining-length or end-position check is omitted, delayed until after the probe, or not propagated to the helper performing lookahead.
invalid_assumption: A following character is available whenever the current position is treated as a possible candidate start or search position.
failure: The routine reads one element beyond the supplied input, producing an out-of-bounds access detectable by memory-safety instrumentation and potentially terminating the process instead of completing normally.
search_strategy: Check every multi-character candidate probe for an explicit remaining-length test before reading the following character.
Inspect optimized mismatch and skip branches for current-position-plus-one accesses when the current position can be the final valid position.
Verify that helpers receive a buffer and length sufficient for every lookahead they may perform.
Exercise candidate misses and multi-character representations exactly at the input boundary under memory-safety instrumentation.

evidence.supports: A character encoder tested multi-character representations through a helper given only the current character; a boundary case caused a read of the next element, requiring bounded input and conditional population of that element.

An optimized text-search path inspected the character after the current position during mismatch and skip handling, including at the last possible position; an explicit boundary guard removed the out-of-bounds read.

scope_note: Both reports establish unchecked one-element lookahead at a text-input boundary, but the mechanisms differ: encoding candidate selection versus optimized substring-search skipping. The umbrella pattern is limited to speculative neighboring-character access in boundary-sensitive text processing.
